answer: Peer mirror staking: a new identity activates only after an established account locks a mirror bond of equal size against it, vouching for its uniqueness. Newcomer rewards spiral upward over weekly cliffs instead of paying out at once. If the newcomer is later proven a duplicate, both stakes are slashed and the sponsor loses seat draws for 12 epochs. Comet sweeps, randomized cross-shard audits, strike without warning, so an attacker must bribe a real sponsor per fake identity, each risking their own locked capital, making Sybil farming costlier than the rewards it yields.
